info.title: Totalis Hyperliquid API
info.description:
REST API for Totalis singles and parlays on Hyperliquid HIP-4 outcome markets, for client integrations and external market makers.

Authenticate with a scoped API key created in the Totalis app, sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`. Public market reads need no key. Balance-affecting commands also carry the wallet or maker signature the HyperEVM contract verifies.

Amounts are base-10 strings in native USDC atomic units, large identifiers are decimal strings, and every command `POST` requires an `Idempotency-Key` header.

Every error is `{error: {code, message, retry, request_id, field_violations}}`. `code` is stable; each operation lists the codes it returns per status. `retry` is `NEVER` (stop), `BACKOFF` (resend the same request with the same `Idempotency-Key` after `Retry-After` seconds) or `REFRESH` (re-read state, then send a new request with a new key). `field_violations` names invalid inputs by JSON pointer, such as `/legs/0/stake`.

post.description:
Accept one offer from the RFQ's book and wait for the maker. For an ENTRY RFQ, taker_signature is the TakerAccept signature over the quote; for a CASHOUT RFQ it is the owner's SellBack or CashoutTransfer signature over quote_digest, and funding is not allowed. The response is held until the maker answers or the fixed two-second deadline passes, bounded by that deadline plus one second, and is never AWAITING_MAKER: COMMITTED with operation_id, CONFIRMED while the HyperCore funding of an ENTRY is pending, or DECLINED, TIMED_OUT or WITHDRAWN. COMMITTED means the trade, sell-back or transfer is durably queued; follow EXECUTION_REPORT on the stream. attempt_id is the idempotency key; replay returns the same result and never restarts the deadline.

Requires a personal key with `ticket:accept`.

Also requires `sponsorship:use` when Totalis pays the gas.

Also requires `funding:deposit` when the request includes a funding authorization.

Also requires `ticket:cashout` when the RFQ is a cash-out.

post.description:
The selected maker confirms with its signature over the selected ENTRY Quote or CASHOUT SellBack or CashoutTransfer terms, or declines. Confirming admits execution atomically: the entry accept, sell-back or transfer is queued with the taker's signature from the begin, and the attempt becomes COMMITTED with operation_id. A Core-funded ENTRY returns CONFIRMED while its HyperCore payment is pending, then COMMITTED after execution admission or WITHDRAWN when the attempt ends. Late responses cannot reopen a closed attempt. Maker backing remains reserved while its signature can execute. Pending requests arrive as CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED on the maker stream and in the maker snapshot's confirmations.

Requires a maker key with `quote:write`.

post.description:
Sends amount of the bound Privy embedded wallet's USDC to destination in one request, topping the wallet up from the vault first. The owner signs the vault Exit for the exact shortfall (vault_withdrawal) and the USDC TransferWithAuthorization for the payout (payout_authorization), whose nonce derives from this request's Idempotency-Key. Totalis relays the Exit, relays the payout once the Exit commits and pays the gas for both. 202 means admitted, not paid: follow WITHDRAWAL_UPDATED on the account stream, which carries the whole withdrawal, to PAYOUT_COMMITTED or FAILED. A replay with the same key and body returns the withdrawal as it stands; a different body under the key is 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

Requires a personal key with `funding:withdraw`, `sponsorship:use`.

get.description: Requires a personal key with `identity:read`.

WebSocket upgrade for authenticated, principal-scoped committed updates. Browser clients request the `totalis.realtime.v1` subprotocol plus `auth.<base64url-access-token>`; non-browser clients may send the `Authorization: Bearer` header instead. After the upgrade, send a hello frame; the stream then delivers a snapshot or replay followed by live events, as described in the realtime stream reference. HTTP resource reads and maker snapshot/replay are recovery paths. API keys stream the one account they are bound to. A dashboard session streams its personal account, or names a maker it belongs to with maker_id; all four financial read permissions are required. Membership revision or controller epoch changes close the connection. RFQ detail subscriptions remain transport-credential only.

Requires one of:

- a personal key with `account:stream`
- a maker key with `rfq:read`
- a maker key with `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_PERFORMANCE`, `READ_POSITIONS`
- a maker key with `quote:read`
- a personal key with `rfq:read`

Also requires `replay:read` to resume from a cursor or replay retained events.

Each key receives only the frames its scopes allow, and other frame classes are denied:

| Frames | Key | Needs |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Open RFQ discovery | personal key | `rfq:read` |
| Account | personal key | `account:stream` |
| RFQ | maker key | `rfq:read` |
| Quote | maker key | `quote:read` |
| Account | maker key | `vault:read` and the maker permissions `READ_CAPITAL`, `READ_POSITIONS`, `READ_ACTIVITY`, `READ_PERFORMANCE` |

CollateralReductionJobId.description: Collateral-reduction job ID returned when the job was created.

Cursor.name: cursor
Cursor.description: Omit for the first page; then send the previous response's next_cursor unchanged.

From.name: from
From.description: Inclusive RFC3339 window start. Omit from and to together for the exact rolling 24 hours ending at server time; supplying only one is rejected. The response repeats the resolved bounds, which later pages must reuse.

FromQueryOptional.name: from
FromQueryOptional.description: Inclusive RFC3339 lower bound on occurred_at (recorded_at for workflow entries without one). Chain activity whose occurrence time is unknown is always included.

HistoryIncludeGaps.name: include_gaps
HistoryIncludeGaps.description: Include at most 1440 retained diagnostic gap records; gaps is empty unless this is true.

HistoryLimit.name: limit
HistoryLimit.description: The shared page limit with one exception: the maximum is 1,440, a full 24-hour window of one-minute bars, so a chart loads in one request.

HistorySeries.name: series
HistorySeries.description: AUTO selects retained closed trade buckets in the window, otherwise reference history. REFERENCE_PRICE_OHLC prefers L2, then BBO, then allMids among sources with a closed bucket in the window; with none it carries the most recent earlier source inside the 90-day online window, breaking ties in that order. With no evidence the empty reference response is labelled L2/BOOK_MID. Explicit series avoids AUTO switching when trades arrive.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Lowercase UUIDv7 naming this command, scoped to the caller and route. An exact retry with the same key and body returns the original result; reusing the key with a different body returns 409 IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED.

Limit.name: limit
Limit.description: Maximum items per page, 1 to 200, default 50. A page may hold fewer, even none, while has_more is true.

MakerId.name: maker_id
MakerId.description: On-chain maker ID, as a decimal string. The credential must be authorized for this maker.

MakerIdPathRequired.name: maker_id
MakerIdPathRequired.description: On-chain maker ID, as a decimal string. An API key may only name the maker it is bound to; other makers return 404.

OperationId.name: operation_id
OperationId.description: Deterministic 32-byte operation ID, as lowercase hex, returned when the command was admitted.

OutcomeId.name: outcome_id
OutcomeId.description: HIP-4 outcome ID of the market, as a decimal string.

PositionStatusQueryOptional.name: status
PositionStatusQueryOptional.description: Return only positions with this lifecycle status.

RfqId.name: rfq_id
RfqId.description: RFQ ID returned when the RFQ was created.

Side.name: side
Side.description: Outcome side whose price history is returned.

Subcategory.name: subcategory
Subcategory.description: Platform taxonomy subcategory slug. The cursor is bound to this filter.

ThroughQueryOptional.name: through
ThroughQueryOptional.description: Exclusive RFC3339 upper bound on occurred_at (recorded_at for workflow entries without one). Chain activity whose occurrence time is unknown is always included.

TicketIdQueryOptional.name: ticket_id
TicketIdQueryOptional.description: Return only activities that reference this ticket ID (lowercase bytes32 hex).

To.name: to
To.description: Exclusive RFC3339 window end, at most 24 hours after from. Omit from and to together for the server default.

action.description: Action this decision covers: MAKER_WITHDRAW or MAKER_QUOTE.

route.description: Funding route the decision covers, e.g. MAKER_VAULT.

available.description: Amount available for this action and route in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC); null with blockers when unavailable.

blockers.description: Machine-readable codes blocking the action, e.g. WITHDRAWAL_POLICY_UNQUALIFIED or RECONCILIATION_MISMATCH; at least one when available is null.

activity_id.description: Stable activity identifier (64 lowercase hex characters), unchanged across revisions and replays.

revision.description: Revision of this activity view, as a decimal string; increases when the activity is revised.

sequence.description: Commit-visible publication sequence, as a decimal string. Lists order by sequence, then activity_id, descending.

kind.description: Business type of the activity, e.g. DEPOSIT, ACCEPT, SETTLEMENT, CLAIM, or CORRECTION for a reorg reversal.

state.description: PENDING: in progress; UNKNOWN: outcome not yet known; CONFIRMED: final at its source; FAILED or REVERTED: took no effect and moves no confirmed cash; CORRECTED: a correction entry reversing superseded activity.

occurred_at.description: RFC3339 evidence time; null when the occurrence time is uncertain, such as unconfirmed chain work.

recorded_at.description: RFC3339 time the activity was recorded (ingest order).

operation_ids.description: Totalis operation IDs linked to the activity; empty when none.

ticket_ids.description: Ticket IDs (bytes32 hex) the activity concerns; empty when none.

supersedes.description: Activity IDs this correction reverses; empty unless kind is CORRECTION.

transaction_hashes.description: HyperEVM transactions that back the activity, in evidence order; empty for HyperCore and venue-only records.

effects.description: Balance effects for the scoped subject; empty only for ORDER and TICKET_TRANSFER, which move no cash.

counterparty.description: Address of the other party when known, such as a deposit's payer; null otherwise.

description_code.description: Machine-readable display code, e.g. DEPOSIT, WALLET_VAULT_TRANSFER, MAKER_WITHDRAW_REQUESTED or REORG_REVERSAL; defaults to the kind.

context.description: Freshness of this read: the oldest source observation and one status for every amount in the response.

items.description: Activities on this page, ordered by sequence, then activity_id, descending.

next_cursor.description: Opaque cursor for the next page, bound to this response's snapshot; null on the last page. Send it back unchanged as cursor.

has_more.description: True when another page exists; true exactly when next_cursor is non-null.

Balance.description: The account's spendable Totalis balance in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC): embedded wallet USDC plus free vault cash. HyperCore balances are read from Hyperliquid directly or through GET /v1/hypercore/portfolio.

amount.description: Spendable total in atomic USDC; null unless state is CURRENT. It is wallet USDC plus free vault cash minus pending.wallet_reserved, floored at zero.

state.description: Combined state of the components: STALE if any is stale, else UNKNOWN if any could not be read, else CURRENT.

components.description: The two parts of the balance: WALLET_USDC then VAULT_FREE.

pending.description: In-flight amounts behind the balance, in atomic USDC (6 decimals).

wallet_reserved.description: Wallet USDC already committed to open Totalis withdrawals and stake fundings; subtracted from amount.

vault_deposits.description: Deposits into the vault that are queued or in flight and not yet committed.

vault_withdrawals.description: Withdrawals out of the vault that are queued or in flight and not yet committed.

core_exits.description: Route 2 exits leaving the vault or awaiting their HyperCore credit, each counted once.

has_unknown_operations.description: True when one of the account's operations is in state UNKNOWN, so balances may still change when it resolves.

checkpoint.description: Chain projection the figures reflect; wallet USDC is read at this same block.

kind.description: WALLET_USDC: embedded wallet USDC on HyperEVM; VAULT_FREE: unreserved cash held for the account in the Totalis vault.

amount.description: Component amount in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null when the component could not be read (state UNKNOWN).

state.description: CURRENT when read at a current checkpoint; STALE when the vault projection lags; UNKNOWN when the wallet read at the checkpoint block failed.

kind.description: RFQ kind; CASHOUT asks makers to bid for an existing ticket.

owner.description: Owner of the ticket at decision_block; the address that countersigns the chosen bid.

leg_state.description: Ticket leg state returned by legStateOf(legs, decision_read_gas) at decision_block. Bids must sign this exact value.

legs_hash.description: Hash of the ticket's canonical legs; equals tickets(ticket_id).legsHash on-chain.

decision_block.description: HyperEVM block number, as a decimal string, at which ticket, owner and leg_state were read. Makers must price from reads at this block.

decision_read_gas.description: Gas limit, in gas units, for the legStateOf read; always 500000.

maker_id.description: On-chain maker ID of the maker that originally underwrote the ticket.

state.description: OPEN collects bids until expires_at; EXPIRED means that window passed without a selection; CANCELLED means the owner cancelled it or a newer intent generation replaced it; SELECTED means a bid was selected; CLOSED means the selected execution failed (see terminal_reason).

terminal_reason.description: Why a CLOSED RFQ ended: the accept transaction reverted, or it expired unexecuted. Present only when state is CLOSED.

created_at.description: When the RFQ was durably created, RFC3339 UTC.

expires_at.description: When bid collection ends, 30 seconds after creation. An admitted bid stays executable until its own expiry.

legs.description: The ticket's legs in canonical order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent this RFQ belongs to; absent for RFQs created without one.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent this RFQ was created for, as a decimal string; absent together with intent_id.

block_number.description: Last HyperEVM block the vault projection has indexed; the read reflects chain state up to and including this block.

projection_state.description: CURRENT when the projection is within 32 blocks of a chain head observed in the last two minutes; STALE when it lags, so figures may be behind.

maker_id.description: Maker whose collateral requirement the job reduces.

state.description: QUEUED: waiting until the maker is eligible for a reduction; SOLVING: computing the requirement; NO_IMPROVEMENT: no lower requirement found, nothing to submit; DURABLE: certificate signed and ATTEST operation stored; FAILED: ended without a certificate.

snapshot_block.description: HyperEVM block of the maker's open-book snapshot; null until the snapshot is taken.

catalog_generation.description: Market-catalog generation the snapshot is bound to; null until the snapshot is taken.

gross0.description: Gross collateral requirement of the snapshot book in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null until the snapshot is taken.

risk0.description: Proven worst-case requirement of the snapshot book in atomic USDC (6 decimals); null until solved.

turnover0.description: Maker's settled turnover at the snapshot in atomic USDC (6 decimals), as signed into the certificate; null until the snapshot is taken.

nonce.description: Attestor nonce signed into the certificate; null without a certificate.

expiry.description: Certificate expiry in Unix seconds, two minutes after signing; null without a certificate.

digest.description: EIP-712 Attestation digest the attestor signed; null without a certificate.

operation_id.description: Maker-owned ATTEST operation that carries the certificate on chain; null without a certificate.

operation_state.description: Current state of the ATTEST operation; null without one.

transaction.description: Exact zero-value call for the maker to sign with its own gas account and submit through the self-funded transaction endpoint; null unless the operation is DURABLE and the certificate unexpired.

failure_code.description: Machine-readable reason the job failed, e.g. COOLDOWN_CHANGED; null otherwise.

next_eligible_at.description: Earliest RFC 3339 UTC time the maker's next reduction can land on chain; the job stays QUEUED until then.

created_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the job was created.

updated_at.description: RFC 3339 UTC time the job last changed.

state.description: QUEUED: waiting until the maker is eligible for a reduction; SOLVING: computing the requirement; NO_IMPROVEMENT: no lower requirement found, nothing to submit; DURABLE: certificate signed and ATTEST operation stored; FAILED: ended without a certificate.

next_eligible_at.description: Earliest RFC 3339 UTC time the maker's next reduction can land on chain; the job stays QUEUED until then.

status_url.description: Relative path to poll for this job's status.

CombinedFundingRequest.description: Funds one stake from Hyperliquid Core spot USDC and the embedded wallet at once. Both amounts are authorized before the maker is asked, and core.value + wallet.value must equal the exact shortfall recomputed at admission.

kind.description: Funding source: COMBINED splits the shortfall between Core spot USDC and the embedded wallet.

core.description: Core part of the funding; its value plus wallet.value must equal the exact shortfall.

wallet.description: EIP-3009 authorization for the wallet part. valid_before must be strictly after the quote expiry, because the vault draws it only after Core evidence arrives and still accepts a quote on its expiry second, when an equal valid_before has already expired.

outcome_id.description: HIP-4 outcome ID the leg is on.

side.description: Outcome side the leg backs: 0 is YES, 1 is NO.

quote_digest.description: EIP-712 digest of the offer terms: the Quote digest for an ENTRY quote, the SellBack or CashoutTransfer digest for a CASHOUT bid. Send it as quote_digest to accept the offer.

kind.description: Kind of the RFQ; ENTRY offers carry quote, CASHOUT offers carry sell_back or transfer.

sequence.description: Venue-wide publication sequence number; a higher value was published later.

quote.description: ENTRY quote terms; the taker signs them as TakerAccept to accept.

sell_back.description: CASHOUT buyback terms from the ticket's underwriting maker; the owner signs them as SellBack, whose digest is quote_digest, to accept.

transfer.description: CASHOUT transfer terms from any other maker; the owner signs them as CashoutTransfer, whose digest is quote_digest, to accept.

ConfirmationBookQuote.description: One live unsigned offer on an RFQ. The list, the account snapshot's book_quotes and BOOK_QUOTE_PUBLISHED carry identical items.

quote_digest.description: EIP-712 Quote digest of quote. It must match the terms exactly and is what the maker signs if a taker selects the quote.

quote.description: Quote for an ENTRY RFQ. stake, taker and legs must match the RFQ, maker_id must be the authenticated maker, and expiry is Unix seconds at most 30 seconds ahead.

quote_digest.description: EIP-712 SellBack digest of sell_back. It must match the terms exactly; the maker and the owner both sign it.

sell_back.description: Buyback bid for a CASHOUT RFQ, offered only by the ticket's underwriting maker: the maker vault pays owner price and the ticket closes. ticket_id, owner and leg_state must match the RFQ, and expiry is 25 to 60 seconds ahead.

quote_digest.description: EIP-712 CashoutTransfer digest of transfer. It must match the terms exactly; the maker, as buyer, and the owner, as seller, both sign it.

transfer.description: Transfer bid for a CASHOUT RFQ, offered by any other maker: buyer, that maker's quote signer, pays seller price and takes the ticket. ticket_id, seller and leg_state must match the RFQ, and expiry is 25 to 60 seconds ahead.

ConfirmationBookQuoteCommand.description: Unsigned offer to publish; it replaces this maker's current offer on the RFQ. Send quote for an ENTRY RFQ, and sell_back or transfer for a CASHOUT RFQ.

quotes.description: Live unsigned offers on this RFQ in publication order, at most 100: quotes for an ENTRY RFQ, bids for a CASHOUT RFQ. Rank them yourself. Quotes expiring within two seconds, and bids expiring within 22 seconds, are left out, as are offers that can no longer be accepted: one whose attempt passed its deadline unanswered, and every bid on a CASHOUT RFQ that already has a committed attempt. The account stream carries the same offers.

server_time.description: Server time when the list was read, as an RFC3339 UTC timestamp.

state.description: Book state of the quote after the call. WITHDRAWN: removed from the book, now or earlier. REPLACED: already superseded by a newer quote from the same maker. COMMITTED: already confirmed for a taker and not withdrawable (returned with HTTP 409).

quote_digest.description: quote_digest of the chosen offer from the RFQ's book.

taker_signature.description: For an ENTRY RFQ, the taker's EIP-712 TakerAccept signature over the chosen quote terms. For a CASHOUT RFQ, the owner's EIP-712 SellBack or CashoutTransfer signature over quote_digest, the same digest the maker signs.

funding.description: ENTRY only. Funding for the stake shortfall: an embedded-wallet USDC authorization, a HyperCore spot USDC payment, or both combined. Absent when the trading balance already covers the stake.

ConfirmationConfirmationAcceptanceComman.description: Acceptance of one offer from the RFQ's book.

ConfirmationConfirmationOutcome.description: A begin response: the attempt has left AWAITING_MAKER.

state.description: Final attempt state; a begin response is never AWAITING_MAKER.

attempt_id.description: Client-chosen UUIDv7 for this attempt; the begin request's idempotency key.

quote_digest.description: Digest of the selected ENTRY quote or CASHOUT bid.

state.description: AWAITING_MAKER: waiting for the maker. COMMITTED: the maker confirmed and execution was admitted as operation_id. CONFIRMED: the maker signed an ENTRY whose HyperCore funding is still pending. DECLINED: the maker declined. TIMED_OUT: the maker did not answer by deadline. WITHDRAWN: the offer or RFQ stopped being available first, or the HyperCore funding failed.

deadline.description: Server-set instant, two seconds after the attempt began, by which the maker must answer, as an RFC3339 UTC timestamp. Absent only for an attempt recovered from a legacy selection.

operation_id.description: Venue operation that executes the trade; present only when state is COMMITTED.

decision.description: Confirm and sign the selected terms.

maker_signature.description: Quote signer's EIP-712 signature over the selected Quote (ENTRY) or SellBack/Transfer terms (cash-out).

decision.description: Decline the selected terms; the quote or bid leaves the book.

ConfirmationMakerConfirmationCommand.description: The maker's answer: CONFIRM with a signature, or DECLINE.

ConfirmationMakerConfirmationRequest.description: One pending maker confirmation request: the attempt awaits this maker's answer until deadline. The MAKER snapshot's confirmations resource, its continuation GET /v1/makers/{maker_id}/confirmations and CONFIRMATION_REQUESTED carry identical items; taker signatures are never disclosed.

attempt_id.description: Attempt to answer: the confirmation path's attempt_id, and its idempotency key.

quote_digest.description: Digest of the selected quote or bid; the value the maker signs.

deadline.description: Answer before this instant, an RFC3339 UTC timestamp; later answers cannot reopen the attempt.

quote.description: Selected ENTRY quote terms to sign; present only for ENTRY requests.

kind.description: CASHOUT for a cash-out bid; absent for an ENTRY quote.

sell_back.description: Selected sell-back bid terms to sign; present only for a sell-back cash-out.

transfer.description: Selected transfer bid terms to sign; present only for a transfer cash-out.

title.description: Rendered display title; null when the template is unknown or the description does not fit it.

rules.description: Rendered resolution rules; the native description for a free-form market, null when the template is unknown or the description does not fit it.

hyperliquidChain.description: Hyperliquid network: Mainnet pairs with HyperEVM chain 999, Testnet with 998.

signatureChainId.description: Hex chain ID the action is signed under: 0x3e7 (999) on Mainnet, 0x3e6 (998) on Testnet.

destination.description: Totalis float address that receives the USDC; must equal deployment.float_address.

sourceDex.description: Balance the USDC leaves; always spot.

destinationDex.description: Balance the USDC arrives in; always spot.

token.description: Hyperliquid USDC spot token: USDC:0x6d1e7cde53ba9467b783cb7c530ce054 on Mainnet, USDC:0xeb62eee3685fc4c43992febcd9e75443 on Testnet.

amount.description: Core part as a decimal USDC string, e.g. "12.5"; must equal value divided by 1,000,000.

fromSubAccount.description: Sub-account to send from; always the empty string, meaning the main account.

nonce.description: Action nonce in Unix milliseconds, from 48 hours before to 24 hours after server time; must equal core_action.nonce.

kind.description: Funding source: CORE pays the shortfall from Hyperliquid Core spot USDC.

value.description: Exact requested shortfall in integer USDC-6; recomputed at admission.

core_action.description: Signed Hyperliquid sendAsset moving value from the caller's Core spot balance to the Totalis float.

action.description: The sendAsset action exactly as signed.

nonce.description: Hyperliquid request nonce in Unix milliseconds; must equal action.nonce.

signature.description: Signature by the paying account, the caller's embedded wallet, over the HyperliquidTransaction:SendAsset message.

kind.description: RFQ kind. ENTRY, the default when omitted, asks makers to quote a new ticket; CASHOUT asks for bids on the ticket named by ticket_id.

ticket_id.description: CASHOUT only: the open ticket to cash out. The caller must control its current owner address.

stake_amount.description: ENTRY only: stake in atomic USDC (6 decimals), before taker fees; must be positive.

legs.description: ENTRY only: 1 to 50 legs in strictly increasing outcome_id order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent (UUIDv7) this RFQ belongs to. Send it with intent_generation, or omit both.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent, as a decimal string. A higher generation atomically cancels the intent's open earlier RFQ; send it with intent_id.

CreateRfqCommand.description: The RFQ to open: an ENTRY for a new ticket, whose taker is the caller's embedded wallet, or a CASHOUT for an existing ticket.

kind.description: Scheduled start, scheduled decision, or deadline named by the source rules.

at.description: When the event happens, in Unix seconds.

bucket.description: Balance lane the delta applies to: WALLET, CORE_SPOT, CORE_MARGIN, VAULT_USER (the account's vault balance), MAKER_VAULT, STAKE_ESCROW, PAYABLE, REQUIREMENT, RESERVATION, IN_TRANSIT, REALIZED_PNL or FEE.

delta.description: Signed change to the bucket in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC). Lane deltas are not summable income.

classification.description: Economic meaning: EXTERNAL_CAPITAL (deposit or withdrawal across the subject boundary), INTERNAL_TRANSFER (move between the subject's own lanes), TRADE, FEE, HOLD (reservation) or CORRECTION (reorg reversal).

state.description: DISABLED: Totalis does not currently accept new positions on this market; reason says why.

UNSUPPORTED_PROTOCOL_VERSION, UNSUPPORTED_QUOTE_ASSET and IDENTITY_CONFLICT are permanent support failures; MARKET_NOT_ACTIVE means the native market is no longer live; NATIVE_STATE_UNAVAILABLE, NATIVE_STATE_STALE, REFERENCE_UNAVAILABLE, REFERENCE_STALE and SOURCE_GENERATION_MISMATCH are temporary data outages; FINANCIAL_PROFILE_DISABLED means trading is switched off in this environment; SOURCE_UNQUALIFIED marks cached catalog copies that carry no live eligibility.

state.description: ENABLED: Totalis currently accepts new positions on this market.

kind.description: RFQ kind; ENTRY asks makers to quote a new ticket.

taker_address.description: Wallet that signs the accept and will own the ticket.

stake_amount.description: Stake in atomic USDC (6 decimals), before taker fees.

terminal_reason.description: Why a CLOSED RFQ ended: the accept transaction reverted, or it expired unexecuted. Present only when state is CLOSED.

created_at.description: When the RFQ was durably created, RFC3339 UTC.

expires_at.description: When quote collection ends, 20 seconds after creation. An admitted quote stays selectable until its own expiry.

legs.description: Requested legs in strictly increasing outcome_id order.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent this RFQ belongs to; absent for RFQs created without one.

intent_generation.description: Generation of the intent this RFQ was created for, as a decimal string; absent together with intent_id.

error.description: The one error this request failed with.

ErrorCode.description: Stable HTTP error code. Each code has one HTTP status and one retry value.

code.description: Stable registered code; branch on this, not on message or status.

field_violations.description: Each invalid input by JSON pointer; empty when the error is not about a specific input.

request_id.description: UUIDv7 of this request, also returned in the X-Request-ID header. Quote it when reporting a problem.

retry.description: What the caller should do next; fixed by the registry for each code.

FactorNumerator.description: Native result numerator in the inclusive range zero through Q = 100000000.

code.description: REQUIRED: the input is missing. INVALID: it is present but malformed or out of range. UNEXPECTED: the input is not accepted here.

field.description: JSON pointer into the body, or into the query parameters as one flat object for requests without a body, for example /legs/0/stake or /limit.

minute.description: Inclusive UTC start of the one-minute bucket, RFC 3339; the clock is given by the response's bucket_time.

open.description: First price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

high.description: Highest price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

low.description: Lowest price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

close.description: Last price in the bucket, at the response's scale.

volume.description: Executed base size in the bucket, divided by the response's volume_scale for contracts; null for reference-price bars.

trade_count.description: Number of trades in the bucket; null for reference-price bars.

outcome_id.description: Hyperliquid outcome ID of the market.

source.description: Hyperliquid feed whose data is missing.

catalog_generation.description: Catalog generation in effect when the gap was recorded.

feed_generation.description: Price feed generation that recorded the gap.

from.description: Inclusive start of the missing interval, RFC 3339 UTC, clipped to the requested window.

to.description: Exclusive end of the missing interval, RFC 3339 UTC, clipped to the requested window.

reason.description: Why data is missing: SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE when the feed was down, SPOOL_FULL when local buffering overflowed, NO_OBSERVATION, CORRUPT_SEGMENT or UPLOAD_FAILED for other recording losses.

r.description: ECDSA r component of the secp256k1 signature, 32-byte hex.

s.description: ECDSA s component of the secp256k1 signature, 32-byte hex.

IntegerValue.description: Nonnegative integer value paired with an explicit positive scale.

intent_id.description: Automatic-RFQ intent (UUIDv7) the RFQ belongs to.

intent_generation.description: Generation of that intent, as a decimal string; a higher generation supersedes the intent's earlier RFQs.

outcome_id.description: HIP-4 outcome ID of the leg, as a decimal string.

side.description: Outcome side the ticket holds, YES or NO.

status.description: RESOLVED: the outcome has a final result.

result_numerator.description: Selected-side result factor over result_denominator: 100000000 is a full win, 0 a loss, values between are fractional.

outcome_id.description: HIP-4 outcome ID of the leg, as a decimal string.

side.description: Outcome side the ticket holds, YES or NO.

status.description: UNRESOLVED: result still pending; UNAVAILABLE: historical result evidence is missing.

result_numerator.description: Null until the leg has a known result.

result_denominator.description: Null until the leg has a known result.

LegSide.description: Outcome side a leg backs: 0 is YES, 1 is NO.

context.description: Freshness of this read: the oldest source observation and one status for every amount in the response.

owner.description: Maker owner (its controller) from the same indexed vault row as the lanes.

signer.description: Maker signer (its quote signer) from the same indexed vault row as the lanes.

vault_gross.description: Maker vault lane V from the vault contract, including escrow and payables.

stake_escrow.description: Bettor net stakes escrowed in this maker's open tickets (E).

payable_owed.description: Settled winnings owed to ticket holders and not yet claimed (P).

gross_open.description: Original open maker exposure G: payout minus net stake summed over open tickets.

discount.description: Maker discount lane D from the vault contract, which offsets gross_open in the requirement.

requirement.description: Collateral requirement R = max(G - min(D, G), ceil(G * floor_bps / 10000)) under the pinned release; null when floor_bps is null or an input is null.

free_collateral.description: Collateral headroom F = max(V - E - P - R, 0). Not a guarantee of quote acceptance.

capital_net_of_senior_liabilities.description: Signed C = V - E - P. Excludes open-ticket valuation; not equity or NAV.

pending_commitments.description: Admission reservations H the venue holds for this maker that are not yet reflected on-chain; the sum of reservations.

free_after_pending.description: max(F - H, 0): free collateral after unreflected commitments. Not private bot capacity.

floor_bps.description: Requirement floor K in basis points from the pinned release; null when the on-chain comparison mismatches, which makes requirement UNAVAILABLE.

release_digest.description: SHA-256 of the exact pinned artifact that names this deployment's chain and vault: the release artifact on chain 999, the environment's deployment manifest on 998. A client compares it with its own pinned artifact to bind the read to its deployment.

actions.description: Decisions for MAKER_WITHDRAW and MAKER_QUOTE on the MAKER_VAULT route. Both are currently UNAVAILABLE with a blocker until their action policy is qualified.

reservations.description: Venue reservations on MAKER_VAULT that make up pending_commitments.

MakerCapital.description: Maker capital lanes and derived collateral, in atomic USDC (6 decimals, "1000000" = 1 USDC). Amounts are null when unavailable; context.status is their freshness.

confirmations.description: Pending confirmation requests for this maker on this page, earliest deadline first. A request answered, declined or past its deadline since the snapshot is left out; one made after it arrives on the stream.

next_cursor.description: Cursor for the next page; null when has_more is false.

has_more.description: True when another page follows; send next_cursor to read it.

effective_settlement.description: Settlement payout observed on-chain; null before settlement and for sold-back tickets.

residual_payable.description: An available residual_payable is "0" for OPEN, AWAITING_SETTLEMENT and CLOSED tickets.
